pass_meta.note: 11 Nov 2026, run 557, the QA lead's extra tests (blocked)

C1078998.failed_steps: Blocked at step 4: an invoice with no due date stored cannot be made - the app always stores one, from the customer's credit term.
C1078998.source: V1 code baseline (production v26.45.3, ShopView/shopview at fc08f23), AccountReceivableCustomerService.php:66-81: "$row['dueDate'] ? new \DateTime($row['dueDate'], $utc) : CreditTerms::getDueDate($invoiceDate, $creditTerm)" (AR-AP-V1-BASELINE INV-036); PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) is silent.
observed: Made a new Net 30 customer "ZZR No Due Date P66" and an invoice dated 40 days ago (S11315-17888, $40.00): the app stored a due date of Nov 1, 2026 on it straight away.
The work order's Finance page has no Due Date box, and none of its menus offers to edit the invoice's due date (every menu opened and pictured).
So an invoice "with no due date stored" cannot be made on this site; steps 1-3 (open A/R Aging Detail, open every bucket) work, step 4 has nothing to find.
This blocks only this test; every other A/R Detail test runs.
C1078998.todo: What needs to be done: the QA lead decides whether this test is kept (with a way to make its starting data that a tester can follow), reworded, or retired - the app itself will not create this starting data.

C1078999.failed_steps: Blocked at step 4: a bill with no due date cannot be made - a vendor with no credit term gets the bill date as due date, and a missing term is refused.

observed: Vendor "ZZRV No Due Date P66 E" made with an empty credit term; its bill ZZRV-NODUE-E (dated Oct 20) was stored with due date Oct 20, 2026 and shows on A/P Aging Detail 22 days past due.
A vendor with no credit term at all is refused ("credit_term: Missing required parameter").
On the bill's page, Edit offers Invoice Number, Invoice Date and Vendor only; "Due date Oct 20, 2026" is plain text that cannot be cleared.
So a bill "with no due date" cannot be made; this blocks only this test.
